SRR19573609_rep2_d9: R1 length, R2 length, N-content, and quality are all normal and comparable across all four runs; rules out truncation, adapter contamination, or gross quality degradation as an explanation for rep2's near-empty STARsolo counts. R2 base composition shows rep2 (609/610) is modestly more A-rich than rep1 (611/612) (~34% vs ~28% A) - consistent with, but not proof of, a higher proportion of P. vivax-derived (AT-biased) transcript content in the rep2 read pool than STARsolo is capturing; this observation motivated the kallisto pseudoalignment controlled experiment (D036_candidate_processing.tsv, D036_cell_level_rescue.tsv) as the decisive test.
